gold_sql:
SELECT p.*, elev.z AS elevation
FROM pois p
JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT ST_Value(d.rast, 1, p.geometry::geometry) AS z
  FROM public.dem_us d
  WHERE ST_Intersects(d.rast, p.geometry::geometry)
  LIMIT 1
) elev ON elev.z IS NOT NULL
WHERE ST_DWithin(p.geometry::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-99.903421 38.083364)',4326)::geography, 4900)
  AND p.amenity = 'hospital'
  AND elev.z >= 420;
model_output:
```sql
WITH reference_hospital AS (
  SELECT 
    ST_SetSRID(ST_GeomFromText('[3].geo_wkt'), 4326)::geography AS geom
),
elevation_filter AS (
  SELECT 
    rast
  FROM 
    public.dem_us
  WHERE 
    ST_Intersects(
      rast,
      ST_Buffer(reference_hospital.geom, 4900)
    )
),
candidate_hospitals AS (
  SELECT 
    poi.poi_name,
    poi.addr_city,
    poi.addr_state,
    ST_Distance(poi.geometry::geometry, reference_hospital.geom::geometry) AS distance_meters,
    ST_Value(elevation_filter.rast, poi.geometry::geometry) AS elevation_meters
  FROM 
    pois poi
  CROSS JOIN 
    reference_hospital
  CROSS JOIN 
    elevation_filter
  WHERE 
    poi.amenity = 'hospital'
    AND ST_DWithin(poi.geometry::geometry, reference_hospital.geom::geometry, 4900)
    AND ST_Value(elevation_filter.rast, poi.geometry::geometry) >= 420
    AND poi.poi_name != 'Hodgeman County Health Center'
)
SELECT 
  poi_name,
  addr_city,
  addr_state,
  distance_meters,
  elevation_meters
FROM 
  candidate_hospitals
ORDER BY 
  distance_meters ASC;
```
